pages.text: Advanced Stage represents the first great awakening of the Maw. This evolution cannot be granted; it must be seized. Only by slaying the Wither and allowing the beast to feast upon the necrotic essence of the three-headed horror can the Maw ascend to this second level of power. The feast is shared: every hunter who wounded the beast is credited, and their Maws ascend with it. The same holds for each ascension that follows.
This Stage's Feast is the Piglin Pie.
